# #491 Når bør du selge – og når bør du sitte stille?

**Feed**: pengeradet  
**Published**: 2026-10-29  
**Market Sentiment**: Neutral

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This Norwegian personal-finance episode (VG's Dine Penger podcast) is about when to sell investment funds while markets are nervous about a possible AI bubble. Nasdaq 100 is down about 6% from its peak, Korea about 13% in a month, and silver has also fallen; the global index is up 13% in 2026 but only about 3% for Norwegian savers because the krone has strengthened. The hosts' main advice is to hold diversified long-term savings. They give reasons to sell tied to the investor (savings goal reached, needing the money, too much risk to sleep well) and to the fund (it grew too large, the manager left, the fund house was bought, weak returns against the market, mergers, strategy changes), and they recommend rebalancing. No individual stocks are recommended.
